stem:
Carvone occurs in spearmint and a stereoisomer of carvone occurs in caraway seeds. Treating either isomer with hydrogen over a nickel catalyst produces a mixture of isomers with the structural formula $\mathbf{X}$.

{{figure:pdf_visual_01.png}}

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text: State the type of stereoisomerism carvone can show. Explain your answer.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: Write an equation, using molecular formulae, for this conversion of carvone to $\mathbf{X}$.
